disposition.reason: A neighbor appealed the St. Albans ZBA's approval of a right-of-way extension meant to serve a future two-lot subdivision. The court says the subdivision itself is not before it, and access work that precedes a subdivision is not new housing.

evidence.quote: Appellant Susan M. Coleman appealed from the June 13, 2002 decision of the Zoning Board of Adjustment (ZBA) of the Town of St. Albans
request approval of A a 50' ROW extension to serve a 2-lot subdivision per Section 400 & 401.
which he wishes to divide into two lots, one 2.6 acres in area and the other 1.2 acres in area.
proposed right-of-way extension will only serve two single-family dwellings

judgments.note: Person ruling: the subdivision is the earliest decision that counts as new housing; an access approval that precedes it does not.
